charts.question: Untouched-test probabilities are checked, not assumed
charts.supported_finding: Model and calibration choices are fixed before the final source-order split is evaluated.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Predicting response is not the same as estimating incremental lift, customer value, or profit.

charts.question: Capacity planning preserves common campaign shocks
charts.supported_finding: Every capacity option shares adjacent-row block-bootstrap replicates, so probability-best reflects the same campaign perturbations.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Only a randomized campaign can establish incremental effect and ROI.

charts.question: Observed response varies across the campaign sequence
charts.supported_finding: The descriptive view preserves source order and reveals why random row splitting would overstate independence.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Monthly response is observational and may reflect targeting, seasonality, or campaign composition.
